paragraphs.text:
They  flit  through  the  air,  grotesque  winged  silhouettes.  You 
catch abhorrent details in the glow from the clearing: faces of 
fungus, bodies that wiggle and writhe.

Gain 1 point of Cthulhu Mythos. Make a Sanity roll: if you fail, 
lose 1D6 Sanity. Then, go to 253.
